about.title: Ebikukwatako ku KyU Wellness
about.subtitle: Omuyambi w'obulamu bw'obwongo agobererwa AI, yakoleddwa abayizi ba Kyambogo.
about.missionBody: KyU Wellness eyamba abayizi okutegeera amangu obuzibu bw'obwongo, okukozesa engeri z'okweyamba, n'okufuna obuyambi bw'abantu abalala nga kyetaagisa. Tugatta empaka za AI, okukebera, n'enkola ey'obulabe.
about.whoBody: Abayizi ba Kyambogo abayagala ekifo ekyama n'ekitundu okwogera ku kunyigirizibwa kw'emisomo, okutiisa, ennaku, n'ennyikalo eya bulijjo.
about.how1: Yogera n'omuyambi wa AI owa CBT mu Luzungu, n'obuyambi obumanyi Luganda.
about.how2: Kola okukebera (PHQ-9, GAD-7, PSS-10) okutegeera nga bw'oli.
about.how3: Goberera omwooyo n'okukebera kwa buli lunaku ku dashboard yo.
about.how4: Bwe waliwo obulabe, abajjanjabi basobola okutegeezebwa.
about.ethicsBody: KyU Wellness tebala ndwadde, tekuwa mmere z'eddagala, so tesiifuuka obujjanjabi. Mu mbeera ey'amangu, tuukirira counseling y'ekitundu, omuntu gw'osalawo, oba eby'amangu.

resources.title: Eby'obuyambi ku bulamu bw'obwongo
resources.subtitle: Endagiriro n'obuyambi abayizi mu Uganda n'ebweru.
resources.campusCounseling: Counseling / student affairs ku Kyambogo — yogera n'omujjanjabi ku kunyigirizibwa kw'emisomo oba obulamu.
resources.campusClinic: Eddwaliro ly'ekitundu oba erya yunivasite — saba obuyambi ku bulamu bw'obwongo.
resources.campusPeer: Mikwano, wardens, oba abakulembeze ab'ekkanisa/abantu be wesiga.
resources.crisisNote: Bw'oba mu bulabe amangu, lekawo olupapula luno oleete obuyambi mu muntu.

emergency.title: Obuyambi mu mbeera ey'amangu
emergency.lead: Bw'oba osobola okwekwata oba okukwata omuntu omulala, noonya obuyambi amangu mu muntu.
emergency.step1: Genda mu kifo eky'obukuumi olewe ebintu ebiyinza okukozesebwa okwekezza.
emergency.step2: Tuukirira omuntu gw'osalawo omutegeeze nti weetaaga obuyambi kati.
emergency.step3: Genda ku counseling y'ekitundu, eddwaliro, oba eby'amangu amangu.
emergency.notReplacement: Enkola eno ekuwa obuyambi, naye tesiifuuka eddwaliro ly'amangu oba obujjanjabi.
emergency.ground2: Gamba 5 by'olaba, 4 by'owulira ku mubiri, 3 by'owulira.
emergency.ground3: Nywa amazzi, otuule oba oyimirire mu ngeri enywevu.
emergency.contactButabikaDetail: Eddwaliro ly'eggwanga ery'obulamu bw'obwongo e Kampala.
emergency.contactKyuDetail: Saba counseling / dean of students. Tegeeka namba ya faculty counseling.

privacy.title: Enkola y'ebyama
privacy.intro: KyU Wellness ektiisa ebyama byo. Olupapula luno lulaga bye tukungaanya, lwaki, n'engeri gye tubikuuma.
privacy.collect1: Ebikukwatako ku akawunti (email, nickname, faculty, mwaka gw'omisomo).
privacy.collect2: Empaka n'ebibuuzo by'okukebera ebyakozesebwa okukuwa obuyambi.
privacy.collect3: Ebiwandiiko by'omwooyo, okukebera kwa buli lunaku, n'ebiwandiiko bya teknika.
privacy.use1: Okuwa obuyambi bwa AI n'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu.
privacy.use2: Okutegeera obuzibu n'okutegeeza abajjanjabi nga waliwo obulabe.
privacy.use3: Okulongosa enkola n'amakulu agaggattiddwa agatalaga biri.
privacy.shareBody: Tetunda data yo. Abajjanjabi basobola okulaba ebyetaagisa mu mbeera ey'obulabe. Amateeka gayinza okwetaaga okumanyisa mu mbeera ntono.
privacy.rights3: Osobola okusaba okusaanyawo akawunti yo ng'otuukiridde support.
privacy.disclaimerBody: KyU Wellness tesiifuuka obujjanjabi bw'obulamu bw'obwongo oba eby'amangu.

consent.title: Ebyama n'okukkiriza
consent.p1: KyU Wellness ekungaanya amawulire gw'owa (profile, empaka, okukebera) okukuwa obuyambi n'okutegeera obuzibu.
consent.p2Strong: Enkola eno tesiifuuka obujjanjabi bw'obulamu bw'obwongo.
consent.p2Rest: Mu mbeera ey'obulabe, tuyinza okutegeeza abajjanjabi ba yunivasite.
consent.li1: Data yo ekumibwa bulungi era ekozesa obuyambi bw'obulamu kwokka
